b.request: Filter scans to those with chronotag values strictly between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (excluding both endpoints), group by zoneref and healtheval, calculate each group's mean GB per scan minute (skipping nulls), identify groups whose mean exceeds the overall mean of all group means (return nothing if this overall mean is undefined), and report the top 10 groups sorted by the amount of exceeding in descending order (missing values last), showing site code, health/safety status, average ratio, scan count, and exceeding amount unrounded.
b.sql:
WITH filtered_scans AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneref,
    s.gbsize,
    s.spanmin,
    si.healtheval
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND s.gbsize IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL
    AND s.spanmin > 0
),
group_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    zoneref,
    healtheval,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as mean_ratio,
    COUNT(*) as scan_count
  FROM filtered_scans
  GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(mean_ratio) as overall_mean
  FROM group_stats
),
exceeding_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    gs.zoneref,
    gs.healtheval,
    gs.mean_ratio,
    gs.scan_count,
    gs.mean_ratio - os.overall_mean as exceeding_amount
  FROM group_stats gs
  CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
  WHERE os.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
    AND gs.mean_ratio > os.overall_mean
)
SELECT 
  zoneref as site_code,
  healtheval as health_safety_status,
  mean_ratio as average_ratio,
  scan_count,
  exceeding_amount
FROM exceeding_groups
ORDER BY 
  exceeding_amount DESC NULLS LAST,
  zoneref
LIMIT 10;

d.request: Include scans with chronotag strictly between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (excluding endpoints) linked to sites via zoneref, group by site code and healtheval, compute average (gbsize ÷ spanmin) and scan count per group, filter to groups with average strictly above the mean of all group averages, return top 10 by excess-above-mean descending (nulls last) showing site code, healtheval, average ratio, scan count, and excess amount unrounded.
d.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND sc.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.healtheval), global_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as mean_ratio FROM group_averages) SELECT ga.zoneregistry, ga.healtheval, ga.avg_ratio, ga.scan_count, ga.avg_ratio - gm.mean_ratio as excess FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN global_mean gm WHERE ga.avg_ratio > gm.mean_ratio ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

a.request: For scans linked to a site (scan `zoneref` = site code) with a timestamp (`chronotag`, compared as text) strictly after '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and strictly before '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797', excluding both endpoints, group by site code and the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`). For each group, work out the average file size per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`, ignoring missing values) and the number of scans. Compare each group's average with the mean of all the group averages (return nothing if that mean can't be computed), and keep only the groups strictly above it. Show the site code, status, average ratio, scan count and the amount by which the group's average exceeds the mean, unrounded. Sort by that amount from largest to smallest (missing values last) and return the top 10.
a.sql: WITH filtered_scans AS (SELECT s.*, st.healtheval FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, healtheval, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN gbsize / spanmin END) / COUNT(CASE WHEN gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) ELSE NULL END AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM filtered_scans GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM group_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.healtheval, gs.avg_ratio, gs.scan_count, gs.avg_ratio - mc.overall_mean AS exceeds_mean FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc WHERE mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio > mc.overall_mean) SELECT zoneref, healtheval, avg_ratio, scan_count, exceeds_mean FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY exceeds_mean DESC LIMIT 10

c.request: Among scans taken between '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' and '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' (comparing `chronotag` as text) that link to a site via `zoneref`, group by site code and the site's health and safety status (`healtheval`), and get each group's average GB per scan minute (`gbsize` ÷ `spanmin`, skipping missing values) and its scan count. Which groups have an average strictly above the mean of all the group averages? Return nothing if that mean can't be computed. Show the site code, status, average ratio, scan count and the amount by which the group beats the mean, unrounded. Sort by that amount from largest to smallest (missing values last) and return the top 10. Only scans timestamped strictly inside the window are included; scans exactly at either endpoint are excluded.
c.sql: WITH scan_data AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.gbsize, s.spanmin, st.healtheval, CASE WHEN s.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin > 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin ELSE NULL END as ratio FROM scans s JOIN sites st ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'), group_stats AS (SELECT zoneref, healtheval, AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio, COUNT(*) as scan_count FROM scan_data GROUP BY zoneref, healtheval), mean_calc AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) as overall_mean FROM group_stats WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL), filtered_groups AS (SELECT gs.zoneref, gs.healtheval, gs.avg_ratio, gs.scan_count, gs.avg_ratio - mc.overall_mean as beat_amount FROM group_stats gs CROSS JOIN mean_calc mc WHERE mc.overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL AND gs.avg_ratio > mc.overall_mean) SELECT zoneref, healtheval, avg_ratio, scan_count, beat_amount FROM filtered_groups ORDER BY beat_amount DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
